jamie: FYI — noticed a ~7% drop in prefix cache hit-rate on canary after kernel-selector change (canary-0612).

arjun: uhoh. which kernel change? the dynamic-kernel-chooser that switches to fp16-optimized kernels based on seq_len?

jamie: yep. suspect keying mismatch with prefetched KV entries. metrics: prefetch hit-rate went from 82% -> 75% on mixed seq lengths. logs show lots of misses for identical prompts.

mel: can you paste the headers we ask clients to send? might be a normalization / casing issue.

jamie: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "x-rw-cache-opt: opt-in" \n  -H "x-rw-cache-key: sha256:abc123" \n  -d '{"prompt":"Translate to FR: Hello world"}'
```

sofia: we canonicalize model+prompt+kernelHint in the cache key. kernelHint was added last week — clients might not be sending it yet.

arjun: that explains it — kernelHint being part of the key expands keyspace when server picks different kernel. clientless requests -> key mismatch.

mel: solution choices: (a) remove kernelHint from cache key, (b) server-derives kernelHint after keying and migrate entries, (c) add a backward-compat shim mapping old keys -> new keys. prefer (c) short-term.

jamie: also seeing duplicate requests from streaming clients on reconnects. the SDK retry path re-sends initial frames WITHOUT cache headers, causing fresh cache misses and increased load.

sofia: SDK should persist x-rw-cache-opt and x-rw-cache-key across retry frames. @rachel any patch in flight?

rachel: got a PR open: persist-cache-headers-on-retry. it attaches cache headers to reconnect logic and adds a unique request-id to avoid double accounting. small diff.

arjun: key normalization we use currently:
```
def normalize_cache_key(model, prompt, quant, kernelHint):
    return f"{model}:{prompt[:64]}:{quant}:{kernelHint or 'auto'}"
```

mel: perf-bot results? any regression trace?

perf-bot: perf-alert: prefix-cache-hitrate drop 7% on canary-0612 at 2026-02-28T13:12Z. top cause: key entropy increase (kernelHint). see /perf/0612 for flamegraphs and traces.

jamie: proposed rollout: revert kernelHint from keying on canary, land SDK patch that persists headers, run warmup prefill job to re-populate top prefixes, and add ingress telemetry for missing cache headers.

sofia: agree. add server metric ingress.cache_headers.missing and tag by client-version. gives us a migration window view.

rachel: i'll cut SDK patch today. switching opt-in header to explicit boolean: `x-rw-cache-enabled: 1` and persist across streaming frames. will also send client-version in `x-rw-client` header.

jamie: :thumbsup: i'll schedule warmup to prefill top-10k prompts for the affected model versions and a short migration job to map old keys to new keys where feasible.

arjun: one more edge: retry backoff must avoid hammering prefill/cache. add jitter + rate-limit for streaming reconnect retries.

mel: created issue RW-3412 (map-shim + warmup + SDK change). assigning to rachel + infra.

jamie: closing loop — will post an update after SDK patch lands and warmup runs. thanks everyone.
